primary_scope_audit.title: Rouchdi Bahloul and Nobuki Takayama,Local Groebner fan:polyhedral and computational approach
primary_scope_audit.read: Primary Introduction and Section1 definitions of local weights/order homogenization;Section3 closed-fan statement;Section3.1 formal division theorem and its full displayed proof;Section3.2 standard-basis statements;Section3.3 fan description/proof end;Section3.4 proof and linear-subspace restriction read. Commutative Section2 context read selectively,not claimed as a new proof.
primary_scope_audit.exact_tool_scope: The order-homogenized ring has formal power-series coefficients and FINITE differential/homogenizing degree. Its homogeneous left ideals have rational polyhedral closed local Groebner fans. Allowed local weights have u_i<=0 and u_i+v_i>=0. Nonconvergent formal coefficients are allowed. The formal division proof keeps derivative/homogenizing degree bounded while coefficients converge in the variable-adic topology.
primary_scope_audit.warning: The paper explicitly warns that arbitrary division need not hold in the NONhomogenized formal differential-operator ring. Its fan describes initial ideals of the specified homogeneous presentation,not the exact support of an arbitrary selected scalar solution or the actual polynomial-output apolar orders.
primary_scope_audit.adoption: Available formal tool;NOT a new actual gap theorem. No exact compatible actual bifiltration/support comparison was established here. No new producer/algorithm run.

retained_identity_reuse.formula: With lambda(0)=0,D=degP,A_z=z exp(T/z) M_P exp(-T/z)=sum_(j=0)^D z^(1-j)(ad_T)^j(M_P)/j!. Then A_z^m(1)=sum_k T^k(P^m)z^(m-k)/k!,and the actual reversed source is sum_m A_z^m(1)t^m/m!.
retained_identity_reuse.meaning: This reuses the retained finite ad-nilpotence and actual reversed-profile identities. It is not a newly registered normal form or a proof of a new positive class. Fourier exchange makes x-polynomial degree<=D a finite differential order,with formal symbol coefficients and finitely many Laurent z powers.
retained_identity_reuse.missing: Clearing Laurent denominators and homogenizing a presentation do not yet identify a good bifiltration of the ACTUAL output/original-marker module whose orders are these actual profiles. No compatible filtered-image/integration theorem with the needed polynomial-time control was supplied.
